subject: combining location data from multiple methods

messages.author: f5989a05baac184d
messages.subject: combining location data from multiple methods
parts:
Hi Chris,

I was wondering if you had any recommendations for combining data from GPS collars and VHF telemetry. Seems like in theory, it should be possible. We have a few animals where we started the study by VHF collaring animals and then got extra funding to put GPS collars on a subset of the animals we had VHF collared.

The immediate problem I'm running into is that the location error terms are different.

Script
nad83z10 <- "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs +ellps=GRS80 +towgs84=0,0,0"

DATA <- as.telemetry(sk.locs, proj4string=CRS(nad83z10))
plot(DATA)
#this works but gives VHF locations arbitrary HDOP of 100

#try to add in error ellipses
DATA <- as.telemetry(sk.locs, proj4string=CRS(nad83z10))
uere(DATA) <- 1
DATA$COV.x.x <- sk.locs$COV.x.x
DATA$COV.y.y <- sk.locs$COV.y.y
DATA$COV.x.y <- sk.locs$COV.x.y
DATA$VAR.xy <- (DATA$COV.x.x + DATA$COV.y.y)/2
plot(DATA)
#get error: Error in eigen(ERROR[i, , ], only.values = TRUE) :
  infinite or missing values in 'x'

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: combining location data from multiple methods
parts:
Hi Marie,

Yes, my suggestion is to import the different device data in separate files so that as.telemetry() can interpret the error information correctly.
Then get their error information settled, such as calibrating or placing priors on the GPS error. In the simplest case when the GPS errors are not substantial and the sampling rate is not too high, you might be able to get away with uere(GPS.DATA) <- 0.
Finally, merge them together with tbind(), which should merge the error information and sort the timestamps.
If you run into any issues, please let me know.

Best,
Chris
